```{r}

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(DHARMa)
library(ggplot2)

```


```{r}
# 1) Load + standardize column names
df_raw <- read_excel("~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Raw_data/Consortia/SelectedbacterialconsortiavsPinfestans_Combined.xlsx") %>%
  rename(
    Treatment = Treatment,
    Rep = Replicate,
    severity_leaf = Diseased_leaf_area
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = as.factor(Treatment),
    Rep = as.factor(Rep),
    Plant = as.factor(Plant),
    Leaf  = as.factor(Leaf),
    severity_leaf = as.numeric(severity_leaf)
  )


```


```{r}

# 2) Plant is the experimental unit: average leaves within plant
df_plant <- df_raw %>%
  group_by(Rep, Treatment, Plant) %>%
  summarise(severity = mean(severity_leaf, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# 3) Prepare for Gamma (no zeros). Offset should be small.
df_plant <- df_plant %>%
  mutate(severity_pos = severity + 0.5)

# 4) Set reference level for comparisons (infected control)
df_plant <- df_plant %>%
  mutate(Treatment = relevel(Treatment, ref = "Diseased control"))

# 5) Fit mixed model: Treatment fixed, Rep random
m1 <- glmmTMB(
  severity_pos ~ Treatment + (1|Rep),
  family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  data = df_plant
)
summary(m1)


# 6) Diagnostics
res <- simulateResiduals(m1, n = 1000)
plot(res)

# 7) Estimated marginal means
emm <- emmeans(m1, ~ Treatment)

# 8) Dunnett-style: each treatment vs infected control (Diseased control)
contr_pos <- contrast(
  emm,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = "Diseased control",
  adjust = "BH"
)
# On model scale
summary(contr_pos)

#Scientific question is: “Which treatments differ from the diseased control?”
#Then the best-matched procedure is Dunnett (many-to-one). It’s more powerful than BH because it’s designed specifically for #comparisons vs a single control.

contr_pos <- contrast(
  emm,
  method = "trt.vs.ctrl",
  ref = "Diseased control",
  adjust = "dunnettx"   # if supported
)
summary(contr_pos)
summary(contr_pos, type="response")

#checking for Consortia vs individual isolates
library(emmeans)

# Check the exact treatment level names emmeans is using
levs <- levels(emm)$Treatment
levs
# (Make sure these match your names exactly, incl. spaces vs underscores)

# Helper: make a "A - B" contrast vector with zeros for all other treatments
mk_con <- function(A, B, levs){
  v <- setNames(rep(0, length(levs)), levs)
  v[A] <-  1
  v[B] <- -1
  v
}

# Define the exact level names here (must match levs!)
A1 <- "Cons1"
B1 <- "Streptomyces_sp._Pb39"

A2 <- "Cons1"
B2 <- "Pseudarthrobacter_sp._Pb177"

A3 <- "Cons2"
B3 <- "Streptomyces_sp._Pb39"

A4 <- "Cons2"
B4 <- "Bacillus_sp._Pb109"

A5 <- "Cons3"
B5 <- "Pseudarthrobacter_sp._Pb177"

A6 <- "Cons3"
B6 <- "Pseudomonas_sp._Pb460"

cons_list <- list(
  "Cons1 vs Pb39"  = mk_con(A1, B1, levs),
  "Cons1 vs Pb177" = mk_con(A2, B2, levs),
  "Cons2 vs Pb39"  = mk_con(A3, B3, levs),
  "Cons2 vs Pb109" = mk_con(A4, B4, levs),
  "Cons3 vs Pb177" = mk_con(A5, B5, levs),
  "Cons3 vs Pb460" = mk_con(A6, B6, levs)
)

cons_contr <- contrast(emm, method = cons_list, adjust = "BH")

summary(cons_contr)                 # log scale (difference of logs)
summary(cons_contr, type="response")# ratio scale (Cons / single)

#End of consortia vs isolates check

# On response scale (ratios = treated / control)
contr_pos_resp <- summary(contr_pos, type = "response", infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>%
  as.data.frame()

contr_pos_resp

```
Convert ratios to “% reduction in severity” (and CI)
```{r}

# Standardize CI columns (emmeans may output lower.CL/upper.CL or asymp.LCL/asymp.UCL)
if(all(c("lower.CL","upper.CL") %in% names(contr_pos_resp))) {
  contr_pos_resp <- contr_pos_resp %>% rename(CI_low = lower.CL, CI_high = upper.CL)
} else if(all(c("asymp.LCL","asymp.UCL") %in% names(contr_pos_resp))) {
  contr_pos_resp <- contr_pos_resp %>% rename(CI_low = asymp.LCL, CI_high = asymp.UCL)
} else {
  stop("CI columns not found. Run names(contr_pos_resp) and check.")
}

eff_df <- contr_pos_resp %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = gsub(" / Diseased control", "", contrast),
    Treatment = gsub(" - Diseased control", "", Treatment),

    # ratio = mean_treatment / mean_diseased_control
    perc_reduction = (1 - ratio) * 100,

    # transform CI correctly: [low, high] on ratio -> [1-high, 1-low] on reduction
    perc_low  = (1 - CI_high) * 100,
    perc_high = (1 - CI_low)  * 100,
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(perc_reduction))

eff_df %>% select(Treatment, ratio, CI_low, CI_high, perc_reduction, perc_low, perc_high, p.value)

#Save table with rounded decimals

eff_df_out <- eff_df %>%
  mutate(across(c(ratio, CI_low, CI_high), ~ round(.x, 3)),
         across(c(perc_reduction, perc_low, perc_high), ~ round(.x, 1)),
         p.value = signif(p.value, 3))

write.csv(eff_df_out, "~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Outputfiles/eff_df_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)


```

Plot: % reduction vs infected control

```{r}

treat_order <- c(
  "Copper standard", "Nutrient broth", "Diseased control",   # controls together
  "Cons1", "Cons2", "Cons3",                                 # consortia together
  "Pseudarthrobacter_sp._Pb177", "Pseudomonas_sp._Pb460",     # isolates
  "Streptomyces_sp._Pb39", "Bacillus_sp._Pb109"
)

treat_labels <- c(
  "Copper standard" = "Copper standard",
  "Nutrient broth"  = "Nutrient broth",
  "Cons1" = "Cons1 (Pb39+Pb177)",
  "Cons2" = "Cons2 (Pb39+Pb109)",
  "Cons3" = "Cons3 (Pb177+Pb460)",
  "Pseudarthrobacter_sp._Pb177" = "Pseudarthrobacter sp. Pb177",
  "Pseudomonas_sp._Pb460"       = "Pseudomonas sp. Pb460",
  "Streptomyces_sp._Pb39"       = "Streptomyces sp. Pb39",
  "Bacillus_sp._Pb109"          = "Bacillus sp. Pb109"
)



# 3) Prepare plot data + p-value labels
eff_plot <- eff_df %>%
  filter(!Treatment %in% c("Healthy control", "Diseased control")) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = trimws(as.character(Treatment)),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treat_order),
    p_label = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "p<0.001",
                     paste0("p=", format(p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Treatment))


p_bar_v <- ggplot(eff_plot, aes(x = Treatment, y = perc_reduction)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_col(width = 0.50) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = perc_low, ymax = perc_high), width = 0.20, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(y = pmin(perc_high + 4, 103), label = p_label),
            angle = 0, vjust = 0, size = 3.2) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = treat_labels) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Disease reduction vs infected control (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 13, angle = 60, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, face = "italic"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 14),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

p_bar_v



ggsave(
  filename = "BDSf_reduction_vs_control.tiff",
  plot = p_bar_v,
  path = "~/Ad_Planta_Trials/Outputfiles/Plots",
  width = 7.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 300, units = "in",
  device = "tiff", compression = "lzw"
)

```
Rep effects

```{r}

library(dplyr)
#This shows which Rep is “higher/lower severity overall” after accounting for Treatment.
re_rep <- ranef(m1)$cond$Rep %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Rep") %>%
  rename(b_rep = `(Intercept)`)

re_rep

#Plot the Rep effects
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(re_rep, aes(x = Rep, y = b_rep)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(y = "Rep random intercept (log scale)", x = "Rep") +
  theme_bw()


#show Rep effect as % change (back-transformed)
re_rep <- ranef(m1)$cond$Rep %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Rep") %>%
  rename(b_rep = `(Intercept)`) %>%
  mutate(mult = exp(b_rep),
         perc_change = (mult - 1) * 100)

re_rep

```









```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

treat_order <- c(
  "Copper standard", "Nutrient broth", "Diseased control",   # controls together
  "Cons1", "Cons2", "Cons3",                                 # consortia together
  "Pseudarthrobacter_sp._Pb177", "Pseudomonas_sp._Pb460",     # isolates
  "Streptomyces_sp._Pb39", "Bacillus_sp._Pb109"
)

# 1) get diseased-control mean per Rep (so reduction is computed within each run)
ctrl_by_rep <- df_plant %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Diseased control") %>%
  group_by(Rep) %>%
  summarise(ctrl_mean = mean(severity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups="drop")

# 2) compute % reduction per plant relative to diseased control in the same Rep
df_red <- df_plant %>%
  left_join(ctrl_by_rep, by = "Rep") %>%
  mutate(perc_reduction = (1 - severity/ctrl_mean) * 100)

#Drop the controls from the plot
df_red2 <- df_red %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = trimws(as.character(Treatment)),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = treat_order)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Treatment != "Diseased control",
    Treatment != "Healthy control"   # drop it
  ) %>%
  droplevels()
 
# df_red2 = your per-plant % reduction data with Treatment as factor (already ordered)
# eff_df  = your model summary table containing Treatment + sig (***, **, *, ns)

# Make a nice p-value label
eff_lbl <- eff_df %>%
  mutate(
    p_label = case_when(
      is.na(p.value)        ~ "",
      p.value < 0.001       ~ "p<0.001",
      TRUE                  ~ paste0("p=", formatC(p.value, format = "f", digits = 3))
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Treatment, p_label)


# y-position above each treatment distribution
ann <- df_red2 %>%
  group_by(Treatment) %>%
  summarise(y = min(103, max(perc_reduction, na.rm = TRUE) + 6), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(eff_lbl, by = "Treatment")


# 3) plot
ggplot(df_red2, aes(x = Treatment, y = perc_reduction)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, alpha = 0.6, size = 1.6) +
  geom_text(data = ann, aes(x = Treatment, y = y, label = p_label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 105), breaks = seq(0, 100, 20)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 60, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    panel.border = element_rect(color="black", fill = NA)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Treatment", y = "Disease reduction vs infected control (%)")





```
